'''Desert Sands''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] quadrant in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].

==History==
A particularly dangerous area, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] forwarded a word of warning to anyone planning to travel through this quadrant.
